allot.subject: Conversion
allot.text: Arihant Superstructures Limited has informed the Exchange about conversion of Warrants on Preferential Basis under the provisions of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Arihant Superstructures Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 2090000 securities pursuant to conversion of Warrants on Preferential Basis under the provisions of SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018 at its meeting held on Jun 14, 2025

allot.subject: General Updates
